title: The Yen Hits 160: Japan's Intervention Gamble
description: The Japanese yen is plunging toward the psychological 160 mark against the dollar, driven by hot US inflation and Fed rate hike bets. We break down why Tokyo is issuing stern warnings, what intervention actually costs, and how a widening policy gap leaves Japan scrambling.

seo.title: Yen Hits 160: Is Japan Running Out of Ammo?
seo.description: The yen is crashing toward the historic 160 mark as US rate hikes widen the policy gap with Japan. While Tokyo deploys verbal warnings and spends trillions to intervene, history shows these moves only buy time against a stronger dollar. Will Japan's defenses hold, or are reserves running dry? Markets now watch December Fed and BOJ meetings closely, as the interest rate differential dictates whether carry trades unwind and Asian currencies face further volatility in this war of attrition against global rates.
